## Outcome

State the user-visible or developer-visible result.

## Changes

List the contract, behavior, data, and migration changes.

## Verification

List each command and its result. Include focused red and green test evidence for behavior changes.

## Limits

State known limits, unsupported cases, and external gates.

## Documentation

Link updated contracts, ADRs, model cards, or setup instructions.

## Follow-up

Link every remaining task. Do not leave untracked TODOs in the PR body.
